---
title: School Administration
role_visibility: [admin, superadmin]
---
# School dashboard
School admins see all batches and teachers in their own school. The school dashboard shows lessons completed per batch and kit usage.

# Assigning teachers to batches
Open Batches, choose a batch and press Assign Teacher. Pick a teacher from your school. The teacher then sees that batch on their account.

# Adding students
Use Add Students to create student accounts one by one or by uploading a CSV file with name and class columns. Each student receives a username and a temporary password.

# Lab kits inventory
The Labs page lists the kits in your school lab and their status. Mark a kit as under repair if a part is damaged so it is not assigned to a session.
